svg.title: How capshelf shares agent config between projects
svg.desc: A Git data repo holds shared skills, Pi extensions, subagents, and config fragments. The project my-app adds an item, edits it, and promotes the edit back to the data repo. The project other-app keeps the version it pinned; capshelf status reports that a newer version exists, and no file there changes until someone runs capshelf update.
